title: Collections Platform Reference: Due-Date Extension on an Accepted Lump-Sum Settlement
content:
# Lump-Sum Settlement — Granting a Due-Date Extension

## Subject of the rule

This rule fixes the Lump-Sum extension days, the calendar days that one due-date extension adds to the settlement payment of an accepted Lump-Sum Settlement that is not in default and has used fewer extensions than the programme allows; extensions on any other programme are outside this rule. The Lump-Sum Settlement is the single-payment programme of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, and an extension moves the day on which its settlement payment falls due.

## What the platform action does

`extend_lump_sum_settlement_due_date_54e5e409` grants one due-date extension on an accepted Lump-Sum Settlement. One call moves the settlement's single payment later by the given number of calendar days: it adds one to the settlement's extension count, adds the days to the settlement's total extension days, and moves the final payment due date later by the same days; the settlement amount and the amount still to pay are unchanged. The consumer and the agent can see the new due date on the settlement.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `extend_lump_sum_settlement_due_date_54e5e409` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `settlement_id` | the settlement reference number of the accepted Lump-Sum Settlement, as returned by the settlement lookup | identifier |
| `extension_days` | the number of calendar days the extension adds | whole integer of at least 1 |

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary with: `settlement_id`; `extension_days` (integer, the days added by this call); `due_date_extension_count` (integer, extensions granted so far including this one); `extension_days_total` (integer, all days added by extensions); `first_payment_due_date_with_extensions` (YYYY-MM-DD, the payment's due date after all extensions); `final_payment_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). A returned extension count means the extension is on record.

## Hypothetical receipt

On a hypothetical accepted Lump-Sum Settlement with no earlier extension, a call adding a given number of days returns an extension count of 1, an extension days total equal to those days, and a payment due date after extensions that many calendar days later than the first payment due date.
